text:
maria-sales: FYI ACME POC demo just hit repeated 502/503s. Happening ~14:10 PST, demo session against hosted endpoint. Customer blocked.
eli-devex: can you paste a sample request id / curl output? which model/route?
maria-sales: sample curl response:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d
X-RW-Status: throttled
X-RW-Queue: backlog
content-type: application/json

{"error":"service overloaded, try again"}
```
Route: /v1/generate model: gpt-open-8b-default, concurrency ~25 for the session.
ops-oncall: autoscaler triggered at 14:05 but pods didn't spin up fast enough; queue length spiked. saw a runtime rollout at 14:04 which may have caused cold KV caches.
deploy-bot: [deploy] runtime/gpu-inference v2.18 rolled to 10% at 2026-03-21T14:04:12Z by @sahil-eng
sahil-eng: rollout + high concurrency = KV-cache cold starts. large prefix tokens amplify per-token work, batcher backs up.
jordan-support: @maria-sales share a few req ids and I'll pull traces.
maria-sales: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0f4e5d6c, req_0a9b8c7d — same timeframe
kevin-infra: logs for those reqs show 429->503 cascade: batcher overflow -> queue trim -> fail fast. GPU queue hit soft limit. header shows `X-RW-Burst: depleted` and autoscaler noted "scale_up_requested" but provisioning lag ~45s.
ops-oncall: mitigation options: 1) route to lower-latency model variant, 2) enable emergency burstpool, 3) temporary per-route concurrency cap.
sahil-eng: quick workaround applied: route override to gpt-open-8b-low-latency + set max_batch_size=1. Example config:
```
{"route":"/acme/demo","model":"gpt-open-8b-low-latency","runtime_override":{"max_batch_size":1,"continuous_batching":false}}
```
eli-devex: for POC we can enable "emergency-burst" tag (uses pooled burst capacity, higher cost). @maria-sales note on billing.
maria-sales: customer asked about pricing for 10min burst. rough estimate?
eli-devex: ballpark: burstpool billed ~3x hosted per-token. if demo hits 50k tokens => incremental ~$300. will send exact calc.
jordan-support: creating ticket RH-2026-554 and attaching logs/traces, tagging infra + sales-poc.
ops-oncall: applied route override and emergency-burst for acme-demo for 15m. monitor now.
kevin-infra: confirmed route returning 200s, queue depth normalizing.
maria-sales: customer sees steady responses, demo continuing. thanks team.
sahil-eng: follow-up: add warmup step for major POCs around runtime rollouts and add pre-demo capacity check in sales playbook.
jordan-support: ticket RH-2026-554 assigned to infra + sales-eng for capacity packaging and pricing follow-up.
maria-sales: I'll update ACME and capture feedback for POC checklist. thanks :thumbsup: 
eli-devex: I'll send cost breakdown and recommend short-term Dedicated if they want guaranteed capacity for future demos.
